name: scrapscache
description: Offline-first notes with optional end-to-end encrypted cloud sync
author: Roland Rajcsanyi

scripts.cf:dev: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler d1 migrations apply SCRAPSCACHE_DB --local --env '' && wrangler dev --env ''
scripts.cf:cron:dev: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler d1 migrations apply SCRAPSCACHE_DB --local --env '' && wrangler dev --config cf/wrangler.cron.jsonc --config wrangler.jsonc --env '' --test-scheduled
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler d1 migrations apply SCRAPSCACHE_DB --remote --env '' && wrangler deploy --env '' && wrangler deploy --config cf/wrangler.cron.jsonc --env ''
scripts.cf:deploy:dev: test -n "$SCRAPSCACHE_TICK_SECRET" && test -n "$TURNSTILE_SECRET" && npm run build:cloudflare && python3 scripts/reset_cloudflare_dev.py && wrangler d1 migrations apply SCRAPSCACHE_DB --remote --env dev && wrangler deploy --env dev && printf '%s' "$SCRAPSCACHE_TICK_SECRET" | wrangler secret put SCRAPSCACHE_TICK_SECRET --env dev && printf '%s' "$TURNSTILE_SECRET" | wrangler secret put TURNSTILE_SECRET --env dev && wrangler deploy --config cf/wrangler.cron.jsonc --env dev && printf '%s' "$SCRAPSCACHE_TICK_SECRET" | wrangler secret put SCRAPSCACHE_TICK_SECRET --config cf/wrangler.cron.jsonc --env dev
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
